Method.name: CheckInDeploymentPackageFile
Method.Implementation:
Do ##class(IHC.ITF.SrcCtrlPkg.EnsembleSrcCtrlClass).CheckSvnSetup($get(%session.Data("UsNm")), $get(%session.Data("PsWd"))) Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFileWithUserNm($get(%session.Data("UsNm")), "CheckInDeploymentPackageFile: " _ fName)
set statStr = "" set crFl = ##class(IHC.ITF.SrcCtrlPkg.CreateDeploymentPackage).%New()
set fileNm = crFl.DeployDirectory _ crFl.DeploymentPackageDirec _ fName _".txt"
set file = ##class(%File).%New(fileNm) set stat = file.Open("R") if ($$$ISOK(stat)) { Do file.Close() set stat = crFl.checkInFile(fName _".txt", cmt, $get(%session.Data("UsNm")), $get(%session.Data("PsWd")), .statStr) set retStr = "CheckIn File output: " _ stat _ "; " _ statStr } else { set retStr = "Please create the Deployment Package file: " _ fileNm }
RETURN retStr
